{"summary":"Customers praise swift, personalized help that lets them change non‑refundable tickets or rebook missed flights at no extra cost.[#tk_106513]
When phone lines are congested, users turn to Twitter or DM, receiving prompt assistance after hours of wait.[#tk_2912623]
Gate‑to‑gate rides and terminal transfers are highlighted as standout service that keeps passengers on schedule.[#tk_2708610]
Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, with only about 10% negative, yet most express gratitude for staff care.[#tk_1751270]"}
